# Alfred L. Scanlan Jr LLC

> Maryland law firm in Hagerstown representing people injured in motor
> vehicle accidents and other personal injury matters. The principal
> attorney handles each case directly, from intake through resolution.

## What the firm handles
- Motor vehicle accidents: car, truck and motorcycle collisions, including
  claims involving uninsured and underinsured drivers
- Personal injury: premises liability, slip-and-fall and other injury matters
- Insurance claims: negotiation and litigation against insurance carriers
  for medical expenses, lost wages, and pain and suffering

## Where the firm works
Hagerstown, Washington County, and the rest of Maryland.

## Consultations
Consultations are free.

## Hours
By appointment.
